summary: One database migration for a stated model change that stays safe while the old application code is still serving.

required_inputs.name: model_change
required_inputs.description: The model or schema diff, or the table spec, with file and line

required_inputs.name: current_head
required_inputs.description: Output of the migration tool's head or status command on the target tree

required_inputs.name: table_classification
required_inputs.description: Whether each touched table is tenant-scoped, global, bootstrap or hybrid

required_inputs.name: populated
required_inputs.description: Whether the table has rows in production, which decides backfill sequencing

checklist.rule: The new revision's parent is the single current head; never create a second head
checklist.because: Two Alembic heads aborted every LINDA deploy twice on 2026-09-08 (#224, #226); r3cruit3r's release_migrate.py records the 2026-05-06 branched-migration incident

checklist.rule: Revision ids fit the version table column (32 characters for Alembic)
checklist.because: A 39-character id failed UPDATE alembic_version after the DDL had already run (LINDA #194, #196)

checklist.rule: Add columns nullable or with a server default; never drop or rename a column in the same deploy as code that still reads it
checklist.because: Fly and Vercel run the migration before new code boots while old code serves (LINDA fly.toml release_command, Flex vercel-migrate.mjs)

checklist.rule: A new table with a tenant column ships its tenant policy in the same migration, or is listed as global with a reason
checklist.because: LINDA lead_reports (lead_003) was created after rls_002 with tenant_id and no rls_statements call; the ORM-metadata guard could not see it

checklist.rule: Rehearse the recovery the tool supports: Alembic downgrade and re-upgrade, Prisma generated down-migration
checklist.because: Prisma has no downgrade command, so a shared up-down-up rule would be wrong for Flex (Codex review, 2026-09-21)

checklist.rule: Never edit a migration that has already run anywhere
checklist.because: LINDA Fable 5.1 audit item 11; a stamped history cannot be replayed if its files change

checklist.rule: The revision file is tracked by git before the task closes
checklist.because: r3cruit3r deployed an untracked migration from a local Docker context and CI then failed with Can't locate revision (commit 005b3c0)

checklist.rule: Follow the repository's idempotent style for guards (inspector checks in Alembic, IF NOT EXISTS and duplicate_object blocks in Prisma SQL)
checklist.because: r3cruit3r's fresh-database replay failed until five migrations were guarded (commit e27d845); 36 of 47 Flex migrations use the handwritten idempotent style

checklist.rule: Do not rely on a release script's stamp-on-error path to make a migration pass
checklist.because: r3cruit3r release_migrate.py stamps on DuplicateColumn, which silently hides a migration that re-adds an existing column

checklist.rule: Update every registry the repo keeps for new tables or fields: encrypted-field lists, tenant teardown lists, global-table lists, ARCHITECTURE.md model sections
checklist.because: Flex training-maxes migration spec calls out encrypted-fields.ts and tenant-teardown.ts; LINDA ARCHITECTURE.md must change in the same PR as models.py

checklist.rule: Anything that needs a backfill goes in a separate dry-run-by-default script, never inside the migration
checklist.because: Add, deploy, backfill, remove is the documented sequence in r3cruit3r and Flex planner prompts

done_output: tenant policy present yes or no, with the migration that carries it
one sentence: safe while old code runs because ...
stop_conditions: more than one head on the target tree
the change needs a drop or rename that old code still reads
no scratch database is configured for the rehearsal gate

adapter_fields.name: heads_command
adapter_fields.description: Argument list that prints the current heads or migration status

adapter_fields.name: revision_id_limit
adapter_fields.description: Maximum revision id length, 32 for Alembic, unused for Prisma

adapter_fields.name: idempotent_style_example
adapter_fields.description: Path of a migration that shows the repo's guard style

adapter_fields.name: tenant_policy_hook
adapter_fields.description: How tenant scoping is applied: rls_statements call, tenantId column convention, or user_id predicate

adapter_fields.name: registries
adapter_fields.description: Paths of the lists that must name a new table or field

adapter_fields.name: scratch_db_url
adapter_fields.description: Disposable database URL on 127.0.0.1 for the rehearsal gate

adapter_fields.name: rehearsal_command
adapter_fields.description: Argument list that performs the tool-specific rehearsal against the scratch database
